# Ipsumify

> The friendliest lorem ipsum generator around. Generate beautiful placeholder text with markdown support, themed variants, and a free public API — no signup required.

Ipsumify is a free, open-source web app for designers, writers, and developers who need placeholder text. Output is deterministic: the same parameters and seed always produce identical text, so results are safe to cache and easy to share. Every result the UI can produce is also available from a public REST API that needs no API key.

## Features

- Markdown-ready output: headers, code blocks, blockquotes, lists, and links
- Multiple themes: Lorem Ipsum (classic), Dog-em, Cat-em, Baked-em, and BBQ-em — all Latin-style placeholder text
- Customizable block count (1–20), optional capitalization, and a no-wrap mode for clean copy-paste
- One-click copy to clipboard or download as a `.md` file
- Shareable URLs that encode your exact settings so others see the same output
- Deterministic, seeded output that is friendly to CDN caching

## API

The public REST API requires no API key. Base endpoint: `https://ipsumify.com/api/generate`

- Default (5 blocks, markdown): https://ipsumify.com/api/generate
- Choose how many blocks: https://ipsumify.com/api/generate?blocks=10
- JSON array of individual blocks: https://ipsumify.com/api/generate?format=json&blocks=4
- Plain text, no markdown: https://ipsumify.com/api/generate?format=text&blocks=2
- Rendered HTML: https://ipsumify.com/api/generate?format=html&blocks=3
- Include markdown elements: https://ipsumify.com/api/generate?md=headers,code,lists&blocks=5

Output formats: `markdown` (default), `json`, `text`, `html`. Themes: `lorem`, `dog`, `cat`, `baked`, `bbq`.
